feat(woodii): expose camellia platform config pages (#496)

## Summary
- add `woodii` frontend menu seed records for the missing camellia platform config pages under `universal`
- add `limit` and `sms` menu groups so their child pages are reachable in the main frame
- update the existing `version` node to resolve `version/index.vue` instead of a placeholder route

## Why
The target Vue pages and API clients already exist in `woodii`, but several pages were not reachable through the dynamic menu tree because `b_node` frontend seed data was incomplete.

## Validation
- `python` inline check for target `woodii/src/views/app/universal/*` files
- `python` inline check for `V00000198__add_frontend_nodes_for_platform_config.sql` content
- `python` inline route-map check for expected dynamic view targets

## Risks
- this change only updates menu seed data; runtime visibility still depends on the deployed database applying the new migration
